en: We just got back to the hotel after getting my hair done.
zh: 我们刚做完头发回到酒店。

en: His hairline is like red from like the bleach, and he told me that it was like burning his scalp.
zh: 他的发际线因为漂白变得通红，他还跟我说感觉头皮都在烧。

en: They did almost like 30 minutes of bleach the first time,
zh: 第一次漂了大概30分钟，

en: I got my whole head bleached.
zh: 我把整头头发都漂白了。

en: So when that got washed out, I was like so thankful to be alive.
zh: 所以当他们把漂粉冲掉时，我真是万幸自己还活着。

en: I was terrified the second time.
zh: 第二轮的时候我吓死了。

en: What, you thought it was gonna turn out bad?
zh: 怎么，你以为会漂砸？

en: No, I thought they were gonna do my roots again.
zh: 不，我以为他们又要处理我的发根。

en: They put like a bunch of wax into it,
zh: 他们往头发里抹了好多发蜡，

en: and it still somehow actually looks like darker under here.
zh: 而且下面看起来居然还有点深色感。

en: And then after the salon, we went shopping.
zh: 然后从美发店出来后我们就去逛街了。

en: Okay, I got myself a sweater because I thought it would look really good
zh: 好，我给自己买了一件毛衣，因为我觉得穿一身白的话，

en: if I was wearing all white, like how I am right now, basically.
zh: 差不多就像我现在这样，应该会很好看。

en: That was an impulse decision,
zh: 这完全是个冲动决定，

en: because the guy was like, so you just want to do frosted tips?
zh: 因为那个理发师说，“你只是只想漂个发梢吗？”

en: And then I was just like, nah, let's do the whole head.
zh: 然后我就说，算了，把整个头都漂了吧。

en: Because I was like, I don't want to make this too confusing.
zh: 因为我不想搞得太复杂。

en: I ended up getting my whole head bleached,
zh: 最后我还是整头漂了，

en: and then that took forever.
zh: 整个过程超级久。

en: They had to do my roots.
zh: 他们还要处理发根。

en: It felt like acid was on my head.
zh: 感觉像是把硫酸倒在我头上一样。

en: My scalp was so irritated already.
zh: 我头皮已经超级敏感了。

en: I was like, oh no.
zh: 我当时心想，完了。

en: and that was my roots, and that hurt really bad.
zh: 主要是处理发根，那真的特别痛。

en: so like it feels like really stiff,
zh: 所以现在头发特别硬，

en: but I can't believe that your hair is like so light,
zh: 但我真的不敢相信你的头发这么浅，

en: but they did a really good job of like toning it.
zh: 而且他们调色调得特别好。

en: So the color is perfect,
zh: 颜色特别完美，

en: Let's do a little haul.
zh: 来个小战利品展示吧。

en: Let's start off with Ashley's item.
zh: 先从Ashley买的东西开始。

en: White palace sweater. So cute.
zh: Palace的白色毛衣。好看！
